item.title: D66, VVD, and CDA report major progress on financial agreements after overnight talks
item.description: Negotiations between D66, VVD, and CDA over the finances for the incoming Dutch government have made significant progress, but the deal is not yet finalized, party leaders said Sunday morning.

item.title: Video: Man killed, woman seriously injured in head-on collision on N377 near Dedemsvaart
item.description: A 55-year-old man from Assen died Saturday morning after a head-on collision on the N377 near Dedemsvaart, just over the Drenthe border, police said.

item.title: Dutch charity grants 25,000th final wish for terminally ill patient
item.description: Stichting Ambulance Wens, a Dutch charity that fulfills final wishes for terminally ill and immobile patients, has reached a milestone by granting its 25,000th request.

item.title: German, Dutch police look for two Dutch drivers who fled after crash left man injured
item.description: German and Dutch authorities are searching for two Dutch drivers after a serious crash on the A31 early Sunday left a 50-year-old man seriously injured.

item.title: PSV stalled by NAC as Feyenoord and Ajax win two in a row
item.description: PSV Eindhoven failed to beat NAC Breda at home on Saturday.

item.title: First-time home buyers eager to purchase, but opportunities lagging
item.description: First-time Dutch homebuyers remain eager to enter the housing market, but opportunities to purchase homes remain limited, according to new data from real estate website Funda.

item.title: Schiphol quits X, citing limited reach, rising misinformation
item.description: Schiphol Airport has stopped using the social media platform X, citing limited reach and concerns about misinformation and hateful content.

item.title: Fewer organ transplants in Netherlands last year; Trend still increasing
item.description: Last year, slightly fewer patients received a donor organ in the Netherlands than in 2024.
